newsitem.title: JAPAN: Barclays Bank, Hokkaido-Takushoku in tie-up talks.
newsitem.headline: Barclays Bank, Hokkaido-Takushoku in tie-up talks.

text.p: Barclays Bank and Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd have agreed to begin discussions on several areas for cooperation, including the development of new financial products and securitisation of Hokkaido Takushoku's assets, the two banks said on Monday.

"The discussion will focus on opportunities for the development and distribution of new financial products in the domestic market, the securitisation of some of Hokkaido Takushoku's assets, and providing clients access to the international capital markets for debt, equity and foreign exchange," the two banks said in a joint statement.
A Hokkaido Takushoku executive told a news conference that neither bank had any intention of taking a stake in the other.
Asked about the securitisation of Hokkaido Takushoku's assets, he said that the details of the discussions will emerge in the future, but the securitisation would probably include housing loans.
